title: Gailani et al. (2020) · NMC cycle-life experiment
finding: Samsung NMC: 80% SOH after 3,000 test cycles at 35 °C and 75% depth of discharge. / Samsung NMC: 80% SOH posle 3.000 ciklusa pri 35 °C i 75% dubine pražnjenja.
limit: A different cell and a specified protocol; test cycles are not automatically full energy-equivalent cycles or an e-208 lifetime prediction. / Druga ćelija i protokol, ne prognoza veka e-208.

title: Luh & Blank (2024) · NMC/C-SiO aging dataset
finding: 228 cells across 76 aging conditions, including calendar, cycling and driving profiles, 0–40 °C. / 228 ćelija, 76 uslova starenja, kalendarsko i ciklično starenje i profili vožnje, 0–40 °C.
limit: Useful for studying how conditions change aging, not a validated CATL calibration for this vehicle. / Pokazuje važnost uslova; nije potvrđen CATL model ovog vozila.

title: NREL / Journal of The Electrochemical Society (2022), 169 080518
finding: Aging models distinguish calendar time and cumulative cycling throughput; Ah-based EFC may use total charge throughput divided by twice nominal Ah. / Razlikuje kalendarsko vreme i protok naelektrisanja; Ah-EFC može koristiti ukupni protok podeljen sa 2 × nominalni Ah.
limit: This report separately labels its discharge-kWh / fixed initial-kWh measure as energy-equivalent cycles. It is not the same metric as Ah-based EFC. / Energetski ekvivalent iz ovog izveštaja nije isto što i Ah-EFC.
